newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cobleskill-Richmondville, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
COBLESKILL-RICHMONDVILLE CENTRAL SCHOOL DISTRICT
SCHOHARIE, OTSEGO AND MONTGOMERY COUNTIES,
NEW YORK
GENERAL OBLIGATION SCHOOL DISTRICT (SERIAL) BONDS, 1996
(BOOK-ENTRY-ONLY) (BANK QUALIFIED)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the
President of the Board of Education of Cobleskill-
Richmondville Central School District, Schoharie, Otsego and
Montgomery Counties, New York at the offices of Chase
Investment Services Corp., Fixed Income Department, 21st
Floor, One Chase Square, Rochester, New York 14643, until
11:30 A.M., Prevailing Time, on
Tuesday, November 26, 1996
at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the
purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued
interest of $9,000,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1996,
(the "Bonds"), maturing (without option of prior redemption)
on June 15 of each year as follows:
MATURITIES
The Bonds will be dated December 15, 1996 and will bear
interest payable semi annually on June 15 and December 15 of
each year commencing June 15, 1997.
The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to
purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will
produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the
terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The School District will designate the Bonds as "qualified
tax-exempt obligations" pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the
Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only
system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New
York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds.
The School District will furnish the Bonds and the approving
legal opinion of Hodgson, Russ, Andrews, Woods & Goodyear,
LLP, Albany, New York, on or about December 18, 1996.
The School District reserves the right to change the time
and/or date for the opening of bids. Notice of any such
change shall be provided not less than 48 hours prior to the
time set forth above for the opening of bids by means of a
supplemental notice of sale to be transmitted over The
Munifacts Wire.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale he
summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds
and such other information as the State Comptroller may
prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Bernard P.
Donegan, Inc., PO Box 70, Victor, New York 14564; Phone
Dated: November 13, 1996 Edward J. Zuchorski, Jr.
(From The Bond Buyer)
